title: DUNGEON RAZE
description:
DUNGEON RAZE is an intense power-trip where you don't crawl through the dungeon, you blast through it. Become a destruction magic-wielding witch and reduce every wall and defense system to dust.

Demolish Everything in SightNot even the walls of the dungeon can stop you. Tear through the map to hunt down gold, power-ups, and rescue allies. Your firepower vaporizes the dungeon as you go.

Experience Instant Hyper-InflationForget grinding for gradual stat upgrades and go for explosive growth. Power scaling that defies logic is achievable within minutes. Watch your projectiles multiply, and your damage skyrocket until even the toughest walls satisfyingly crumble in a single shot.

Lead a Mobile FortressNo one razes alone. Smash through the rubble to rescue imprisoned adventurers and add their firepower to your own. As your squad grows and your inflation peaks, the screen fills with a chaotic storm of magic and munitions that no defense can withstand.

Push Your Destructive LimitsFind out just how much devastation you can unleash:

Speed Raze: How fast can you raze the core? A time-based mode where every second counts.

Eternal Dungeon: No limits, no end. See how far your ""hyper-inflated"" firepower can go in a procedurally generated maze of infinite destruction.

Hard Dungeon: High-difficulty stages filled with tougher walls and enemies, designed to challenge your ultimate power. Encounter special allies and powerful, unknown foes.
description_short: Demolish walls to grow stronger! DUNGEON RAZE is a high-octane top-down shooter that fuses strategic destruction with exponential power scaling. Smash through the environment with overwhelming, "hyper-inflated" firepower to rescue allies and collect power-ups.
